approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: The 189 delta (PR #192) reworded REQ-reporting-001 — direct-native-write events (REQ-history-013) start or end no segment and are not an unrecognised kind — but missed updating the pinned digest in tests/spec_split.rs, so CI failed in the MSRV, Product and Fledge jobs; test-only fix, canonical specs unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test --locked --test spec_split passes with the pinned digest matching the materialized REQ-reporting-001 wording, and PR #192's full CI is green

send_backs.reason: tasks.md lists 'Full CI green on PR #192' as a task, but CI only runs after ship and push, so it can never be ticked at check time and check refuses; the CI expectation stays in change.md's acceptance criteria and testing.md, and only that task bullet is removed (Leif chose the send-back route via orc t18, 2026-11-06)
